lead_raw_text:
The structure of ErCoSi crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms (Er4Co4Si4) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers with 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, Er centers with 16 neighbors, and Si centers with 9 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Co and Er polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Co and Si polyhedra.
